name: PADINI
recent: Padini 近期出现大量大股东与董事的股权变动申报，包括 YONG PANG CHAUN、CHONG CHIN LIN 及 EPF 等，同时董事在闭市期內增持股份。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度录得净亏损 964 万令吉，营收同比下滑 6.7%。新闻方面，公司提出股票回购计划，股价较前期大幅下跌。
notable: 董事 Chong Chin Lin 在闭市期內多次增持公司股份。
公司提出股票回购计划。
公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度录得净亏损。
risks: 季度净亏损 964 万令吉，亏损较去年同期扩大。
营收同比下滑 6.7%，环比下滑 41.4%。
新闻提及成本上升与 SST 扩大可能影响公司表现。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 3.659 亿令吉，同比下滑 6.7%，环比下滑 41.4%；净亏损 964 万令吉，净利率为 -2.6%，而上一期净利率为 9.7%。

recent_en: Padini has seen numerous substantial shareholder and director interest change filings recently, involving YONG PANG CHAUN, CHONG CHIN LIN and EPF, with directors acquiring shares during the closed period. The company reported a net loss of MYR 9.64 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with revenue down 6.7% year-on-year.
notable_en: Director Chong Chin Lin acquired shares multiple times during the closed period.
The company recorded a net loss for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: Quarterly net loss of MYR 9.64 million, with losses widening year-on-year.
News reports mention rising costs and expanded SST may weigh on performance.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 365.94 million, down 6.7% year-on-year and 41.4% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was MYR 9.64 million with a net margin of -2.6%, compared to a net margin of 9.7% in the prior period.
